name: holm quest lodge v2 interior
review_note: Quest board and lectern lead; the reading corner now has a bordered rug, a candle stand with a lit candle and open pages on the bench book; the turret chart carries a title strip and contour lines; the road-door beacon reads.
improve: The hall floor is still mostly open between board and bench; the candle stand and pages are small at the elevated camera; a second lantern and wall-hung notices would fill the west wall.
